Semantics and layouts of register context, task identity beyond numeric identifier, architecture breakpoint operations and low level software breakpoint helpers.
Locking, memory ordering and concurrency rules for shared breakpoint tables and per processor debugger info beyond interrupt masking and relaxed spinning shown.
Complete command set, parsing rules, pager behavior, search handling, environment variables and prompt template details.

findings.text: Main debugger trap entry accepts exception state, classifies cause, prepares breakpoint and pager context, runs interactive loop unless resuming a deferred breakpoint step, then reinstalls breakpoints and selects resume mode.
Public breakpoint maintenance walks the breakpoint table forward to install enabled entries and backward to remove enabled entries, delegating per entry work to internal helpers.

Interactive control loop coordinates secondary processors, invokes per entry command processing, interprets resume requests, clears deferred step marker when single stepping, and drains pending keyboard state before returning.
Query helpers report whether an address matches a removed breakpoint or an active breakpoint, and init memory release clears any breakpoint whose address lies in discarded init sections.

Cross processor stack service handles local case directly and otherwise requests a backtrace from a stopped secondary and waits for completion, while exception and nonmaskable entries build fresh debugger state and request master entry after reentry and readiness checks.

Install is idempotent for already installed entries, clears pending delay unless a deferred step is in progress, defers installation with a single step when marked delayed, otherwise uses software mechanism for zero type and hardware mechanism with length and type otherwise, marking success only on zero return.

Removal is a no operation when not installed, otherwise dispatches by type to software or hardware removal and clears installed marker only on success, while deferral handling arms single step mode and transfers delay marker to delayed marker.
Debug category test checks global flags against a category bit shifted by a common shift, and state tracing helper emits a state print only when the state category is enabled.

Lockdown handling groups memory register and flow permissions into write and read sets, queries platform policy only when relevant enable bits are present, expands blanket enable into explicit mask before reduction, then clears disallowed write and read bits independently.

Command history is a circular buffer with separate head tail and navigation pointer that wraps modulo capacity and overwrites oldest entry on overflow, diagnostics treat nonnegative codes as no error and look up negative codes in a message table, and trailing newline removal strips at most one final line feed.

Debugger console output is suppressed while a debugger session is connected in specific active modes, otherwise it forwards under interrupt masking, and the boot option enables console use and registers once when input output registration has completed.

Reentry check applies only on the active debugger processor, tracks nesting depth, attempts recovery when the faulting address holds a removable software breakpoint, otherwise removes all breakpoints and escalates to panic after more than one level except for a single self debug level when configured, while exception entry bypasses the debugger for non trap faults when automatic reboot on panic is configured.
Register dump temporarily raises console verbosity to most chatty level, brackets register display with trap print nesting accounting, emits a blank line, then restores prior verbosity.
Alternate header provides a no operation definition of keyboard cleanup, indicating builds where no keyboard drain work is required.

Console forwarding masks local interrupts around the low level write and restores them afterwards, and secondary coordination plus keyboard draining use relaxed spinning on shared flags and device status without sleeping or explicit lock acquisition in the shown fragments.

Breakpoint record carries enable and installed markers, fault address, free marker, transient delay and sticky delayed markers, type selector distinguishing software from hardware, and hardware length field used with address and type for hardware operations.

Debugger exception state carries processor number, vector, signal, error code, register context, pass through flag and readiness reference, and per processor info carries entry marker, resume result and exception state bits for slave and backtrace request roles.
Remote breakpoint entry holds a lifecycle state and address, console record holds name, output routine, capability flags and index, and module notifier record wires a callback returning success.

Trap cause starts as fault, switches to processor switch on reentry, keyboard when a breakpoint set is in progress, system nonmaskable on matching error and signal, nonmaskable when in nonmaskable context, breakpoint on address match in enabled table, and single step trap on vector zero with trap signal when no breakpoint matched.

Breakpoint at current program location arms delay markers and a single step breakpoint state, entry skips the interactive loop when that state coincides with a single step trap and instead clears step markers, while resume later reinstalls breakpoints and chooses single step or continue outcome.

Main loop holds secondaries in a spinning wait with liveness refresh, exits early if another processor requested departure, otherwise delegates to local handling and maps its outcome to processor switch, single step arming, remote debugger transition or normal departure, clearing deferred marker when stepping and always cleaning keyboard state.

Local handling announces entry with current task and processor, reports each reason distinctly including register dump on fault and validation of trap outcome for breakpoint and step cases, then loops prompting with processor specific string, maintaining history and grep reset, until a resume class command arrives.

Stack dump handshake requires the target to be marked as stopped slave, sets a want backtrace bit, then spins until the target clears it, with local processor and single processor builds bypassing the handshake.

Pager is enabled for the interactive session and cleared afterwards, catastrophic marker is set on fault reason or fault error and when any online processor has not entered the debugger, and it is cleared after resume decision before architecture specific resume handling.

Primary trap entry and nonmaskable entry are externally invoked on exception and nonmaskable events, zero a fresh state record, populate identity and fault fields, enforce reentry and readiness guards, and hand off to the processor entry routine requesting master role.

Console write hook and module load notifier hook integrate with generic console and module notification frameworks, and a boot time option hook enables debugger console use and performs one time registration when transport is ready.

Recursive debugger entry risks breakpoint corruption and triggers removal of all breakpoints plus panic beyond one nesting level, and entry marks catastrophic state when a fault occurs or when any online processor fails to stop, indicating possible unresponsive peers.

Keyboard cleanup blocks waiting for device output readiness and for a specific break code while discarding mouse data and extended or repeated make codes, and software breakpoint installation can fail with guidance toward alternate modes, leaving the entry uninstalled.

Unexpected local return codes and mismatched trap outcomes are reported rather than acted upon, unknown reasons cause dismissal without entering command processing, and failure to expand blanket enable before clearing would leave overly broad permissions under partial lockdown.
Previous history navigation code is sixteen and next history navigation code is fourteen.
Keyboard drain treats hexadecimal nine C as the awaited break code, hexadecimal E zero as extended prefix to skip, and hexadecimal one C as repeat make to skip.
Debugger console uses index minus one and combines print buffer with enabled capability flags.
